problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/multivariable/14033857/assets/e16f9309d74f81f419ed96e995750bcad21a2770f214c49ee537f22ca25aac2e.png)

Consider the collection of point masses above, where the $x$-coordinates are measured in meters. What is the $x$-coordinate of the center of mass for this system?
worked_solution:
The center of mass, denoted $\overset{―}{x},$ of a collection of point masses ${m}_{1},{m}_{2},…,{m}_{n}$ located at ${x}_{1},{x}_{2},…,{x}_{n}$ along the $x$-axis is given by 

$$
\overset{―}{x}=\frac{{M}_{O}}{m},
$$

 

where 

- $m={\sum }_{i=1}^{n}{m}_{i}$ is the total mass of the system,

- ${M}_{O}={\sum }_{i=1}^{n}{m}_{i}{x}_{i}$ is the total moment of the system about the origin $O.$

In our case, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{m}_{1} & =2, & \,{m}_{2} & =3, & \,{m}_{3} & =4, & \,{m}_{4} & =5, \\ {x}_{1} & =-3, & \,{x}_{2} & =-2, & \,{x}_{3} & =-0.5, & \,{x}_{4} & =2.\end{aligned}
$$

So, the total mass of the system is

$$
\begin{aligned}m & ={\sum }_{i=1}^{n}{m}_{i} \\  & ={m}_{1}+{m}_{2}+{m}_{3}+{m}_{4} \\  & =2+3+4+5 \\  & =14\end{aligned}
$$

and the total moment of the system about the origin is

$$
\begin{aligned}{M}_{O} & ={\sum }_{i=1}^{n}{m}_{i}{x}_{i} \\  & ={m}_{1}{x}_{1}+{m}_{2}{x}_{2}+{m}_{3}{x}_{3}+{m}_{4}{x}_{4} \\  & =2\cdot (-3)+3\cdot (-2)+4\cdot (-0.5)+5\cdot 2 \\  & =-6-6-2+10 \\  & =-4.\end{aligned}
$$

 

Therefore, 

$$
\overset{―}{x}=\frac{{M}_{O}}{m}=\frac{-4}{14}=-\frac{2}{7}.
$$

Question 15
?

Consider the collection of point masses above, where the x-coordinates are measured in meters. What is the x-coordinate of the center of mass for this system?

a
−27
b
 −1
c
 −314
d
 714
e
 47
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

The center of mass, denoted x―, of a collection of point masses m1,m2,…,mn located at x1,x2,…,xn along the x-axis is given by

x―=MOm,

where

  • m=∑i=1nmi is the total mass of the system,

  • MO=∑i=1nmixi is the total moment of the system about the origin O.

In our case, we have

m1=2,m2=3,m3=4,m4=5,x1=−3,x2=−2,x3=−0.5,x4=2.

So, the total mass of the system is

m=∑i=1nmi=m1+m2+m3+m4=2+3+4+5=14

and the total moment of the system about the origin is

MO=∑i=1nmixi=m1x1+m2x2+m3x3+m4x4=2⋅(−3)+3⋅(−2)+4⋅(−0.5)+5⋅2=−6−6−2+10=−4.

Therefore,

x―=MOm=−414=−27.
